nom: Good Molecules Bakuchiol Oil Blend for Oily Skin

segments.oily: Most oily-skin reviewers report reduced shine and fewer breakouts over weeks of nightly use, though several with oily skin say it sat on top of the skin, felt greasy, or worsened oiliness and breakouts, especially when used during the day or over-applied.
segments.dry: Dry-skin and dry-patch reviewers describe it as hydrating and softening, with a couple noting non-oily areas got drier or that the product initially felt too heavy until they reduced the amount.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report balanced oil production, less shine in the T-zone, and softer, smoother skin, with one noting it caused blackheads on the cheeks specifically.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report good tolerance, hydration and glow, but a few describe breakouts, cystic acne, or itchy, irritated red bumps.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (late 30s to mid-50s) report softer, firmer, more even-toned skin and some reduction in the look of fine lines, though one reports no visible change in fine lines or wrinkles after a month.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers in their late 30s to 50s report diminished look of fine lines, firmer and more supple skin, especially around the eyes and forehead; one reviewer using it consistently for a month reports no change in fine lines or elasticity.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers broadly describe the oil as hydrating, leaving skin soft, plump and glowy, including relief for dry patches and dry under-eyes, with only isolated reports of increased dryness in non-oily areas.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin report calmer, less inflamed skin, while one reviewer reports the product caused red, irritated bumps.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers who cannot tolerate retinol report this product being gentler and not disrupting their skin, though one reviewer with damaged barrier and cystic acne reports strong improvement, contrasting with another whose skin flaked/peeled after use.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers mention brightening or more even skin tone and fading of dark spots; sun spots and discoloration are mentioned as improving but not eliminated.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, cleared cystic pimples, and better texture over weeks; several others report the opposite — new cystic acne, purging that didn't resolve, or breakouts appearing and disappearing on reuse.
concerns.oiliness: A large number of oily-skin reviewers report visibly less shine and reduced oil production, particularly in the T-zone, over consistent nightly use; several others report the opposite — a persistently oily, greasy film, especially when used during the day or in larger amounts.

extraits.texte: I have very oily skin, using this during the day was a horrible decision. the oil broke through before I even left the house. I tried using it at night & woke up with an oily face & didn't get much better even after washing.

extraits.titre: great glow for oily, sensitive skin
extraits.texte: my skin situation: i'm 38 with lines making themselves quite comfortable across my forehead and slightly coming in around my marionette area. i'm white with some sun spots and increased freckling. my skin is oily with noticeable but not large pores, and i am prone to occasional break outs- well, i used to be. i only use this product at night, as it definitely does leave my skin a little shinier than i want during the day. that being said, since starting to use it nightly, my skin is so much smoother, brighter, plumper, and more hydrated. i feel like a new person! i use it second to last no matter what other treatment i am doing, and i put a thick moisturizer over it. my skin was looking tired and dull, and now i don't even bother with make up.

I had been using a regular retinol which was okay but I was over the 'burn' of redness the next day. Also, I would get a random deep cystic pimple and that's not okay. I have an oily t-zone and combination and sensitive skin and I was hesitant to try an oil, but I knew Bakuchiol would be more gentle. I use it 5-6 nights per week cycled with 1-2 nights of glycolic toner. This seems to be the magic combo! Six weeks in and I haven't had a single cystic pimple. My t-zone is majorly less oily and I've gone from multiple powder touch-ups during the day to one or two, max, which results in better looking makeup all day. My skin is less textured and more even toned and a little glowy, which is something I previously avoided with oilier skin. As for the review regarding smell, which dissipates quickly, it's not bad. I'd rather it doesn't smell like chemicals or fragrance. The price point is excellent and its clean and cruelty-free. I hope this never goes away cause I love it!!!!

I have very sensitive acne prone dry skin and this has been absolutely amazing. You will purge at first so start slowly, but now I am a couple of months in and use it daily and it keeps my skin so hydrated and really helps with my acne!

I have so many issues with retinol; it doesn't matter which one I buy or how much I try to buffer it, my skin becomes inflamed and angry. When I found this bakuchiol, I was so excited because I finally found a product that works for me! I can use this 2-3 times a week and I feel it has helped with my fine lines over time! I hope this product stays around for a long long time because it is truly one of my holy grails!

extraits.titre: Bakuchiol oil blend, great alternative for retinol beginners
extraits.texte: I really liked the bakuchiol oil blend, my skin doesn't feel greasy and it's a very good alternative if you are a retinol beginner, like I am. I do have blackheads in my cheeks, but when I put the oil in my cheeks I get a lot more, so since I like the product a lot I just avoid using it in that part of my face (I'm aware that it can be purging, that's why I don't mind it a lot). I also love to use it in my neck and chest. I've been using ir for about two or three weeks, I hope to see results in the next couple of months.

First day was great my skin looked hydrated and not super oily. the next day my face kept getting itchy and started to break out. The next day I started to develop swollen acne like bumps on my face. I stopped using this and my skin stated to clear up again but started to to get dry in my non oily areas. I tried it again with the same results.
